comparison.objective: Juice a lemon half, transfer the spent half, and leave juice in the bowl.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual fixture stabilization, twisting compression, and wet-object transfer, not impact-tool alignment.
comparison.success_condition: Lemon is squeezed dry, juice remains in bowl, spent half reaches saucer, and arms retreat; numeric yield/spill thresholds are not stated.
comparison.reason: Shares stabilization and force control only at a generic level; the mechanism and outcome differ.
